name: Tarot Club
startIntroPart1: Above the grey fog, in a palace untouched by time, a long bronze table stood surrounded by twenty-two empty chairs — and when Klein Moretti opened his eyes there, no longer in Tingen but in a place that should not exist, he found himself seated at its head before two bewildered strangers pulled from their own dreams, and with a calm he did not truly feel, he folded his hands, let the mist curl around them, and spoke the words that would change all their fates: Welcome to the Tarot Club.
startIntroPart2: I woke up in Klein Moretti's body, in a damp, unfamiliar room in Tingen, with another man's memories stabbing into my skull and a world of Beyonders, secret churches, and mad gods waiting outside my door — and instead of panicking, I smiled, because in my old life I was no one, but here, in this world where knowledge was power and mystery was currency, I saw my chance: I would learn its rules, climb its pathways, gather followers in the fog above, and turn this second life into an empire, until the day even gods would have to whisper my name — The Fool.
declaringWar: From this day forward, there will be no more hiding, no more running, no more kneeling to gods who feed on fear, and as the Tarot Club rose behind me, cards in hand and faith in their eyes, I raised my hand and spoke the words that would shake every church, every kingdom, and every god in this world: I, The Fool, declare war.
attacked: You think you can kill me? I have died once already, I have walked through madness, through fog, through the gaze of gods — and I am still here. Strike me down, and I will return. Break my palace, and I will rebuild it in your dreams. You came to end The Fool... but you have only given me a reason to show you why even gods fear my name.
defeated: You have the guts to call my body a corpse but beware, I know what will happen to our future- our tiberium future.
introduction: The fool who doesn't belong this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog, The king of yellow and black who wields good luck.
tradeRequest: Should we have A session of Equivalent Exchange?

name: Church of the Evernight
startIntroPart1: Darkness is not the absence of light, but the rest that all things return to. In the silent night, we watch over dreams and death.
startIntroPart2: From the cathedrals of Backlund to the quiet streets of Tingen, the night belongs to us. We are the guardians of sleep, of secrets, and of the final rest.
declaringWar: The night has fallen. Those who disturb the peace of the night shall face eternal slumber.
attacked: You dare strike in the darkness? The night itself will swallow your army.
defeated: Even in defeat, the night remains. We shall return with the next dusk, for darkness never truly dies.
introduction: We are the servants of the Evernight Goddess, keeper of darkness, dreams, and the underworld. May the Goddess bless your night.
tradeRequest: Shall we have a session of Equivalent Exchange under the moonlight?

name: Church of the Lord of Storms
startIntroPart1: The sea roars, the thunder cracks. The Storm does not ask permission — it takes.
startIntroPart2: From Pritz Harbor to Bayam, every sailor knows: bow to the storm, or be broken by it.
declaringWar: The storm is coming! Let thunder be our war drums and lightning be our spears!
attacked: You dare challenge the sea and sky? Your fleet will be swallowed by the waves!
defeated: The storm may calm, but it never dies. We shall gather again on the horizon.
introduction: I speak for the Lord of Storms, ruler of sea, thunder, and wind. Kneel, or be swept away.
tradeRequest: Shall we trade before the storm hits?

name: Church of Knowledge
leaderName: The God of Knowledge and Wisdom
startIntroPart1: Knowledge is the only true light. Ignorance is the greatest sin.
startIntroPart2: In our libraries, in our academies, we collect all that is known, and seek all that is unknown.
declaringWar: You have chosen ignorance over wisdom. We shall correct your error — with knowledge and with force.
attacked: You attack the keepers of knowledge? Your folly will be recorded in history as a warning.
defeated: Knowledge cannot be destroyed. Even if our temples fall, our books will live on.
introduction: We are the seekers of truth, the keepers of all knowledge. Ask, and you shall learn.
tradeRequest: Shall we exchange knowledge, as equals?
uniques: [-15]% Science cost of researching new Technologies

name: Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun
startIntroPart1: The Sun rises, and darkness flees. We are the light that purifies all corruption.
startIntroPart2: From the grand cathedrals of the Intis Republic, our light shines upon the world, burning away all heresy.
declaringWar: In the name of the Sun, we purge! Let holy fire cleanse this land of darkness!
attacked: You dare raise your sword against the light? You shall be burned to ash!
defeated: The Sun may set, but it always rises again. Our light will return.
introduction: We are the children of the Sun, bringers of light and justice. Bow before the eternal flame.
tradeRequest: Shall we trade in the light of the Sun?

name: Church of the Earth Mother
startIntroPart1: The earth gives life, the earth takes life. We are all children of the soil.
startIntroPart2: In fields and forests, in harvest and birth, the Mother watches over us all.
declaringWar: You have poisoned the land and harmed her children. The earth itself shall rise against you!
attacked: You strike at life itself? The earth will swallow your armies.
defeated: Even in winter, the seed sleeps beneath the soil. We shall bloom again in spring.
introduction: We are the children of the Earth Mother, nurturers of life, harvest, and healing. May your fields be fertile.
tradeRequest: Shall we share the bounty of the earth?

name: Church of the God of Combat
startIntroPart1: War is not chaos. War is art. War is the proof of strength.
startIntroPart2: We do not fear battle. We live for it. Only the strong deserve to rule.
declaringWar: Finally! A worthy battle! Let steel sing and blood flow! For the God of Combat!
attacked: You come to us for war? You have chosen wisely. We accept your challenge!
defeated: We fought with honor. Even in death, we die as warriors. Remember us.
introduction: We are warriors of the God of Combat. Strength is truth. Prove yourself on the battlefield.
tradeRequest: Trade? We prefer to take what we need. But... we shall listen.

name: Church of Steam and Machinery
leaderName: The God of Steam and Machinery
startIntroPart1: Steam hisses, gears turn, the world moves forward. The old gods fear progress. We embrace it.
startIntroPart2: In workshops and factories, we build the future — one engine, one invention at a time.
declaringWar: Your outdated ways cannot stop progress. Our machines shall crush you!
attacked: You attack the builders of the future? Your weapons are already obsolete.
defeated: A machine can be broken, but the blueprint remains. We shall rebuild, stronger than before.
introduction: We are the engineers of the future, followers of Steam and Machinery. Progress waits for no one.
tradeRequest: Shall we trade blueprints and engines?
